notes: Normal selectable pack. Preserve original friendly Professor Mari identity in khaki safari gear; twelve connected jungle expeditions and matching portraits.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for Safari Professor Mari appearance pack. Identity/style reference: attached original Professor Mari; preserve voluminous blonde shoulder-length curls and cowlick, bright blue eyes, black rectangular glasses, friendly adult feminine chibi proportions and crisp pixel-art rendering with square clusters. Outfit: khaki safari boonie hat with olive band, tan short-sleeve field shirt with two chest pockets, olive cargo trousers, brown hiking boots, brown belt, small olive backpack. Same outfit EVERY frame. Safari gear and jungle explorer scenes. Props: green tropical leaves, field notebook, binoculars, compass and jungle vines where requested. Keep isolated tiny jungle props rather than a full background. EXACT layout four columns FOUR rows, sixteen full-body sprites total, overall atlas 1024x1536, each cell 256x384. Each row is one four-beat chronological action left-to-right. Same scale and foot baseline in every cell, all props fully inside each cell with generous padding. Genuine transparent alpha background; no scenic backdrop, floor, haze, matte, ground shadows, grid lines, lettering, labels or watermark. Pixels crisp, limited palette, no smooth anime illustration. Row1 IDLE: Mari adjusts safari hat; scans jungle with hand shading eyes; notices small tropical leaf; confidently holds binoculars at chest with friendly smile. Row2 THINKING: studies closed field notebook; hand to chin pondering; idea sparks as small lightbulb; confidently points ahead while holding notebook. Row3 RESEARCH: inspects green jungle leaf; studies leaf with magnifier; records detail in notebook; proudly shows same leaf beside notebook. Row4 PLANNING: unrolls jungle trail map; studies map; checks brass compass beside map; points onward while holding rolled map. Mari protagonist in every cell, no other people. Abstract marks on maps and pages, no text.
